title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Apple & Blackcurrant 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid 10mg
description: Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN Apple & Blackcurrant brings a delightful blend of sweet and tangy flavours. Experience the authentic taste of fresh autumnal fruits, with a burst of juicy Apple and sharp, jammy Blackcurrant on the inhale, followed by a smooth, sweet exhale. This e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG formulation ensures a perfect balance of flavour and vapour production, while the nicotine salt formula provides a super-smooth and comfortable throat hit. Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN e-liquids are ideal for use with starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Unlike traditional freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for higher nicotine concentrations without a harsh throat hit. Nicotine salt e-liquids offer faster nicotine absorption, delivering quick relief from cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids an excellent choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate and satisfying nicotine relief. BAR EDTN is a curated collection of nic salt e-liquids inspired by Riot Squad’s popular disposable Riot Bar flavours. Just like the Riot Bars, Bar EDTN keeps the flavours straightforward, sweet, and consistently satisfying, so you always know what to expect. Enjoy this Apple & Blackcurrant flavour and explore the rest of Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN range, including the refreshing Watermelon Ice, classic Cherry Cola, and smooth Mango Vanilla. Whatever your preference, BAR EDTN has a flavour to suit your taste.
